products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI) is a publicly traded global content and technology company that describes itself as delivering "technology with purpose" to professionals in legal, tax, accounting, trade compliance, risk, and fraud sectors. Its site frames its offerings around helping professionals make faster decisions and work more efficiently, with an emphasis on content grounded in what it calls authoritative sources and rigorous data governance.

The company's primary AI product tracked here is CoCounsel, a legal AI built on integration with Westlaw and Practical Law content. Thomson Reuters positions CoCounsel under a framework it calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI," intended for work the company describes as defensible, and the site notes it is launching production-grade agentic workflows on the platform for multi-step legal tasks. A case study on the site cites the firm Justly Prudent as having increased litigation capacity by 100% using CoCounsel and Westlaw AI. Beyond legal, the company also markets ONESOURCE+, an AI-connected platform bringing together tax, trade, legal, and risk functions, as well as an AI tool for Harmonized System code classification in trade compliance.

Thomson Reuters holds CIK 0001075124 with the SEC and its page on this site was verified in August 2026. No litigation or MCP server entries are currently held for the company in this registry.
